description: John (joharnessburg) hooks. SessionStart injects provider-neutral endurance goal + PLAN.md state; PreCompact snapshots workspace state; PostToolUse offloads large file-tool results to .john/trace/ and returns Claude updatedToolOutput or Codex additionalContext pointing to the same digest. Skill invocation telemetry is Claude-only and is reported as unsupported on Codex. All hooks no-op when no .john/ exists at or above cwd. Hooks execute local code with the coding session's permissions; review this declaration and its scripts before trusting a fork.
